description: x.md is a read-only service for turning public X (Twitter) posts, threads, profiles, connections, and search results into Markdown or JSON. It mirrors X URLs on `mdfromx.com` and also offers versioned machine-readable endpoints and an MCP server for agents.
summary: mdfromx.com exposes a public read-only REST API at `https://mdfromx.com/api/v1` with an OpenAPI description at `/openapi.json`, plus a public MCP server at `https://mdfromx.com/mcp` over Streamable HTTP; both are unauthenticated.
